title: veronica agrestis subsp. opaca
intro: Veronica agrestis subsp. opaca, commonly known as Cornish teaberry or Sea Speedwell, is a plant species in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Veronica agrestis subsp. opaca include soothing and calming effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is necessary to fully understand the plant's effects and potential uses, but it has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its purported benefits.
